LIST.EMPTY_TITLE: You haven't declared any service yet
LIST.EMPTY_BODY: Declare the service to be assessed: when done, its control catalog is generated.
LIST.HEADING: Services
LIST.INTRO: Each service is assessed separately, with its own control catalog and connections.
LIST.CONFIRM_ONE: Delete the service “{{name}}”? This action cannot be undone.
LIST.CONFIRM_MANY: Delete {{count}} services? This action cannot be undone.
LIST.BLOCKED_ONE: {{names}} already has recorded assessments or evidence, so it cannot be deleted.
LIST.BLOCKED_MANY: {{names}} already have recorded assessments or evidence, so they cannot be deleted.
LIST.FAILED_ONE: We could not delete 1 more service. Try again.
LIST.FAILED_MANY: We couldn't delete {{count}} others. Try again.

DETAIL.CONNECTIONS_HELP: The ways Monkey reaches your assets. Open one to see what it found.
DETAIL.RISKS_FIRST_BODY: {{pending}} of {{total}} risks are still to be evaluated. Evaluate them before declaring the assets: likelihood and impact change from one service to another.
DETAIL.NO_CONNECTIONS_TITLE: You don't have any connections yet
DETAIL.NO_CONNECTIONS_BODY: Create a connection so Monkey can find this service's assets.

FORM.NEEDS_COMPANY_BODY: A service belongs to an organization. Complete that context and come back here.
FORM.LOAD_ERROR_BODY: Check your connection and try again. What you wrote wasn't lost.
FORM.DONE_CREATED_BODY: “{{name}}” now has its control catalog and risks.
FORM.OWN_COPY: This catalog belongs to your service only: you can adjust it without affecting anyone else.
FORM.RISKS_INTRO: Rate the likelihood and impact of each risk in this service from 1 to 5. That builds your risk matrix and lets you declare the assets.
FORM.S1_BODY: It is the service to be assessed in the compliance consulting. If you have several, declare them one by one.
FORM.DESC_PLACEHOLDER: For example: First- and second-level support for corporate clients, 24 hours a day.
FORM.DESC_HELP: One or two sentences are enough.
FORM.SCOPE_PLACEHOLDER: For example: Who it is provided to, from where, and which part of the service we want reviewed.
FORM.SCOPE_ERROR: State what the assessment must cover.
FORM.SCOPE_HELP: This is the scope: what falls within the review.
FORM.TYPE_HINT: Choose the service type to continue.
FORM.INDUSTRIES_LABEL: Which sectors do you provide the service to?
FORM.MULTI_HELP: You can choose more than one.
FORM.CLIENTS_LABEL: How many active clients does this service have?
FORM.S3_BODY: You can choose more than one option in each question.
FORM.COUNTRIES_LABEL: In which countries is the service provided?
FORM.COUNTRIES_HINT: Choose at least one country or region.
FORM.DATA_LABEL: What kind of data does it handle?
FORM.DATA_HINT: Choose at least one data type.
FORM.AVAILABILITY_LABEL: What availability do your clients expect?
FORM.S4_BODY: Choosing it generates the service's control catalog.
FORM.FRAMEWORK_HELP: You can pick the contracted frameworks. To add another, contact Monkey.
FORM.NO_FRAMEWORK: Your company has no contracted framework yet. Contact Monkey to enable it so you can continue.
FORM.CATEGORIES_LABEL: Which SOC 2 categories will the consulting cover?
FORM.CATEGORIES_HELP: Security is always included. We recommend covering all the categories; add the ones that match what you promise your clients.

SECURITY.HELP: Protecting your systems and your clients' data against unauthorized access. It's the foundation of everything and is always included.
SECURITY.EX1: Who gets in and with what permissions
SECURITY.EX2: How you manage changes and risks
SECURITY.EX3: How you detect and respond to incidents

AVAILABILITY.HELP: That your service is available when your clients need it, and that it recovers if something fails.

CONFIDENTIALITY.HELP: Keeping the information your clients give you as confidential protected throughout its entire life cycle.
CONFIDENTIALITY.EX3: How it is deleted when the contract ends

INTEGRITY.HELP: That your service processes information completely, validly, accurately and on time.

PRIVACY.HELP: Handling personal data as you promised people: what you collect, why, and for how long.
PRIVACY.EX3: Retention and disclosure to third parties

FORM.S5_BODY: Infrastructure providers the service relies on (cloud or your own data center). Select all that apply.
FORM.OPTIONAL_BLANK: optional, you can leave it blank
FORM.PROVIDER_SERVICE: What service does it provide you?
FORM.S6_BODY: Previous certifications and the service's system description.
FORM.SYSDESC_HELP: The document that explains how your service works. Share the link or upload the file; one is enough.
FORM.SYSDESC_LINK_INVALID: Enter a complete link starting with https://
FORM.FILE_RULES: PDF or Word (.docx), up to 25 MB.
FORM.SYSDESC_HINT: Share the link or upload the file (one is enough).
FORM.FILE_ERROR_TYPE: Only PDF or Word (.docx) files are accepted.
FORM.FILE_ERROR_SIZE: The file exceeds the 25 MB maximum.
FORM.OPEN_FILE_ERROR: We couldn't open the file. Try again.
FORM.REVIEW_BODY: Check the details and save them to generate the control catalog. You can edit them later.
FORM.SALES_TITLE: {{name}} is not in your plan yet
FORM.SALES_BODY: {{name}} is not in your plan. Contact Monkey and we will tell you how to add it and when it will be ready.
FORM.COVERAGE_TITLE: We recommend covering all the categories
FORM.COVERAGE_BODY: If you leave categories out, your consulting will only cover the ones you chose. You can continue this way.
FORM.UPLOAD_FAILED: We saved your service, but we couldn't upload the file.
FORM.UPLOAD_RETRY: Try again or use a link.
FORM.NAME_TAKEN: You already have a service with that name. Choose another one to tell them apart.
FORM.FRAMEWORK_NOT_CONTRACTED: Your company does not have that framework contracted yet. Contact Monkey to enable it.
FORM.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save your service. Try again.
FORM.NEEDS_COMPANY_OTHER_BODY: A service belongs to an organization. Your company's administrator must declare that context; then you can come back here.
FORM.CREATED: Service “{{name}}” declared. Continue with its risks.
